metas.name: Facing El Chapo
metas.description: Follows two cops who in a routine stop pull over a stolen car only to come face to face with one of the most dangerous criminals in the world.

metas.name: Wicked
metas.description: Elphaba, a young woman ridiculed for her green skin, and Galinda, a popular girl, become friends at Shiz University in the Land of Oz. After an encounter with the Wonderful Wizard of Oz, their friendship reaches a crossroads.

metas.name: The Equalizer
metas.description: A man who believes he has put his mysterious past behind him cannot stand idly by when he meets a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters.

metas.name: Red Rooms
metas.description: A model becomes obsessed with a high-profile murder trial.

metas.name: A House of Dynamite
metas.description: When a single, unattributed missile is launched at the United States, a race begins to determine who is responsible and how to respond.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
metas.description: Still reeling from the loss of Gamora, Peter Quill rallies his team to defend the universe and one of their own - a mission that could mean the end of the Guardians if not successful.

metas.name: The Butterfly Effect
metas.description: Evan Treborn suffers blackouts during significant events of his life. As he grows up, he finds a way to remember these lost memories and a supernatural way to alter his life by reading his journal.

metas.name: Event Horizon
metas.description: A rescue crew is tasked with investigating the mysterious reappearance of a spaceship that had been lost for seven years.

metas.name: Ocean's Eight
metas.description: Debbie Ocean gathers an all-female crew to attempt an impossible heist at New York City's annual Met Gala.

metas.name: A Beautiful Mind
metas.description: A mathematical genius, John Nash made an astonishing discovery early in his career and stood on the brink of international acclaim. But Nash soon found himself on a harrowing journey of self-discovery.

metas.name: The Game
metas.description: A mysterious game invades a man's ordered existence.

metas.name: The Last Samurai
metas.description: In 19th century Japan, Nathan Algren, a US army captain, is hired by the Japanese emperor to train his army in the modern warfare techniques. Captain Algren finds himself trapped in a struggle between two eras and two worlds.

metas.name: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
metas.description: Luke Skywalker joins forces with a Jedi Knight, a cocky pilot, a Wookiee and two droids to save the galaxy from the Empire's world-destroying battle station, while also attempting to rescue Princess Leia from the mysterious Darth ...

metas.name: The Judge
metas.description: Big-city lawyer Hank Palmer returns to his childhood home where his father, the town's judge, is suspected of murder. Hank sets out to discover the truth; along the way he reconnects with his estranged family.

metas.name: Gladiator II
metas.description: After his home is conquered by the tyrannical emperors who now lead Rome, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum and must look to his past to find strength to return the glory of Rome to its people.

metas.name: The Ring
metas.description: A journalist must investigate a mysterious videotape which seems to cause the death of anyone one week to the day after they view it.

metas.name: Jaws
metas.description: When a massive killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Long Island, it's up to the local police chief, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.

metas.name: Coco
metas.description: Aspiring musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather, a legendary singer.

metas.name: Reservoir Dogs
metas.description: When a simple jewelry heist goes horribly wrong, the surviving criminals begin to suspect that one of them is a police informant.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: This contemporary romantic comedy based on a global bestseller follows native New Yorker Rachel Chu to Singapore to meet her boyfriend's family.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
metas.description: Harry Potter, Ron and Hermione return to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for their third year of study, where they delve into the mystery surrounding an escaped prisoner who poses a dangerous threat to the young wizard.

metas.name: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
metas.description: When the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire rogue's gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.

metas.name: Braveheart
metas.description: Scottish warrior William Wallace leads his countrymen in a rebellion to free his homeland from the tyranny of King Edward I of England.

metas.name: Tombstone
metas.description: A successful lawman's plans to retire anonymously in Tombstone, Arizona, are disrupted by the kind of outlaws he was famous for eliminating.

metas.name: The Blair Witch Project
metas.description: Three film students vanish after traveling into a Maryland forest to film a documentary on the local Blair Witch legend, leaving only their footage behind.

metas.name: Argo
metas.description: Acting under the cover of a Hollywood producer scouting a location for a science fiction film, a CIA agent launches a dangerous operation to rescue six Americans in Tehran during the U.S. hostage crisis in Iran in 1979.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: When Harry Met Sally...
metas.description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

metas.name: Roofman
metas.description: A charismatic criminal, while on the run from the police, hides in a hidden space of a toy store. There, he adopts a new identity and becomes involved with an employee, beginning a relationship as unlikely as it is risky.

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: A family struggles for survival in a world invaded by blind alien creatures with ultra-sensitive hearing.

metas.name: Amadeus
metas.description: The life and work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart seen through the eyes of his contemporary and rival, Antonio Salieri.

metas.name: Little Women
metas.description: In 19th century Massachusetts, the March sisters--Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy--on the threshold of womanhood, go through many ups and downs in life and endeavor to make important decisions about their futures.

metas.name: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
metas.description: Shang-Chi, the master of weaponry-based Kung Fu, is forced to confront his past after being drawn into the Ten Rings organization.

metas.name: Karate Kid: Legends
metas.description: After kung fu prodigy Li Fong relocates to New York City, he attracts unwanted attention from a local karate champion and embarks on a journey to enter the ultimate karate competition with the help of Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso.

metas.name: Pet Sematary
metas.description: After tragedy strikes, a grieving father discovers an ancient burial ground behind his home with the power to raise the dead.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: Through a series of freak occurrences, a group of actors shooting a big-budget war movie are forced to become the soldiers they are portraying.

metas.name: Jungle
metas.description: A group of friends joins a guide for a trek into the Bolivian jungle, searching for an Indian village. The men soon realize that the jungle is a difficult place to be.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: After his master dies, a peasant squire, fueled by his desire for food and glory, creates a new identity for himself as a knight.

metas.name: People We Meet on Vacation
metas.description: Poppy wants to explore the world and Alex prefers to stay home with a good book, but somehow they are the very best of friends. They live far apart, but for a decade they have spent one week of summer vacation together.

metas.name: Fackham Hall
metas.description: A new porter forms an odd bond with the youngest daughter of a well-known UK family. As the Davenport family, headed by Lord and Lady Davenport, deals with the epic disaster of the wedding of their eldest daughter to her caddish c...

metas.name: Killers of the Flower Moon
metas.description: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one - until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: On the way to the biggest race of his life, a hotshot rookie race car gets stranded in a rundown town and learns that winning isn't everything in life.

metas.name: Toy Story 2
metas.description: When Woody is stolen by a toy collector, Buzz and his friends set out on a rescue mission to save Woody before he becomes a museum toy property with his roundup gang Jessie, Prospector, and Bullseye.

metas.name: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
metas.description: Jack Reacher must uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy in order to clear his name while on the run as a fugitive from the law.

metas.name: Dream Scenario
metas.description: An ordinary family man finds his life turned upside down when strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams.

metas.name: Her
metas.description: In the near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.

metas.name: Ready Player One
metas.description: When the creator of a virtual reality called the OASIS dies, he makes a posthumous challenge to all OASIS users to find his Easter Egg, which will give the finder his fortune and control of his world.

metas.name: The Help
metas.description: An aspiring author during the civil rights movement of the 1960s decides to write a book detailing the African American maids' point of view on the white families for which they work, and the hardships they go through on a daily b...

metas.name: We Live in Time
metas.description: After an unusual encounter, a talented chef and a recently divorcée fall in love and build the home and family they've always dreamed of, until a painful truth puts their love story to the test.

metas.name: The Conjuring: Last Rites
metas.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront.

metas.name: Don't Look Up
metas.description: Two low-level astronomers must go on a giant media tour to warn humankind of an approaching comet that will destroy planet Earth.

metas.name: Predator: Badlands
metas.description: A young Predator outcast from his clan finds an unlikely ally on his journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

metas.name: The Accountant
metas.description: As a math savant uncooks the books for a new client, the treasury department closes in on his activities and the body count starts to rise.

metas.name: Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: Beca, a freshman at Barden University, is cajoled into joining The Bellas, her school's all-girls singing group. Injecting some much needed energy into their repertoire, The Bellas take on their male rivals in a campus competition.

metas.name: Love Actually
metas.description: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

metas.name: Black Widow
metas.description: Natasha Romanoff confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises.

metas.name: Twister
metas.description: Two storm chasers on the brink of divorce must work together to create an advanced weather alert system by putting themselves in the cross-hairs of extremely violent tornadoes.

metas.name: They Live
metas.description: They influence our decisions without us knowing it. They numb our senses without us feeling it. They control our lives without us realizing it. They live.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: Lion prince Simba and his father are targeted by his bitter uncle, who wants to ascend the throne himself.

metas.name: Barbie
metas.description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the outside world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among regular humans.

metas.name: Materialists
metas.description: An ambitious young New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

metas.name: The Man in the Iron Mask
metas.description: The cruel King Louis XIV of France has a secret twin brother whom he keeps imprisoned. Can the twin be substituted for the real king?

metas.name: Perfect Days
metas.description: Hirayama cleans public toilets in Tokyo, lives his life in simplicity and daily tranquility. Some encounters also lead him to reflect on himself.

metas.name: Superbad
metas.description: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

metas.name: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
metas.description: A reluctant Hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home and the gold within it from the dragon Smaug.

metas.name: We're the Millers
metas.description: A veteran pot dealer creates a fake family as part of his plan to move a huge shipment of weed into the U.S. from Mexico.

metas.name: Halloween
metas.description: After being committed for 15 years, Michael Myers, now a grown man and still very dangerous, escapes from the mental institution and immediately returns to Haddonfield to find his baby sister, Laurie.

metas.name: Raiders of the Lost Ark
metas.description: In 1936, archaeologist Indiana Jones is tasked by Army Intelligence to help locate a legendary ancient power, the Ark of Covenant, before the Nazis get it first.

metas.name: The Wild Robot
metas.description: A sentient robot stranded on an uninhabited island raises an orphaned gosling while trying to fit in with the local wildlife.

metas.name: Bullet Train

metas.name: Gerald's Game

metas.name: The Outsiders

metas.name: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark

metas.name: Babylon
metas.description: A tale of outsized ambition and outrageous excess, it traces the rise and fall of multiple characters during an era of unbridled decadence and depravity in early Hollywood.

metas.name: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
metas.description: While trying to manage her own life and career, a woman on the verge of a breakdown must cope with her daughter's illness, an absent husband, a missing person, and an unusual relationship with her therapist.

metas.name: Underworld
metas.description: Selene, a vampire warrior, is entrenched in a conflict between vampires and werewolves, while falling in love with Michael, a human who is sought by werewolves for unknown reasons.

metas.name: Once Upon a Time in America

metas.name: The Idea of You

metas.name: The Lives of Others

metas.name: Exit 8
metas.description: A man becomes increasingly desperate when he realizes he is trapped in a subway station, needing to complete a mission to get out.

metas.name: Signs
metas.description: A widowed former reverend living with his children and brother on a Pennsylvania farm finds mysterious crop circles in their fields, which suggests something more frightening to come.

metas.name: Videodrome

metas.name: The Nice Guys
metas.description: In 1970s Los Angeles, a mismatched pair of private eyes investigate a missing girl and the mysterious death of a porn star.

metas.name: Alice in Wonderland
metas.description: Nineteen-year-old Alice returns to the magical world from her childhood adventure, where she reunites with her old friends and learns of her true destiny: to end the Red Queen's reign of terror.

metas.name: The Irishman

metas.name: An American Werewolf in London

metas.name: American Gangster

metas.name: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

metas.name: Heel
metas.description: A 19-year-old criminal, Tommy, is kidnapped and forced into a rehabilitation process by a dysfunctional couple, Chris and Kathryn, who try to make him a "good boy." Tommy must find a way to escape.

metas.name: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
metas.description: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape from Earth and return to his home planet.

metas.name: Train to Busan
metas.description: While a zombie virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

metas.name: Oddity
metas.description: A psychic medium attempts to uncover the truth behind her sister's murder at the site of the crime.

metas.name: Young Frankenstein

metas.name: Resident Evil: Apocalypse

metas.name: Outlander

metas.name: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
metas.description: Four teenagers are sucked into a magical video game, and the only way they can escape is to work together to finish the game.

metas.name: The Order
metas.description: A series of bank robberies and car heists frightens communities in the Pacific Northwest. A lone FBI agent believes that the crimes were not the work of financially motivated criminals but rather a group of dangerous domestic terr...

metas.name: American Pie
metas.description: Four teenage boys enter a pact to lose their virginity by prom night.

metas.name: Anatomy of a Fall
metas.description: A woman is suspected of murder after her husband's death; their half-blind son faces a moral dilemma as the main witness.
